comment: Ported from the QWELK N.E.W.S module. The Round, Clamp, Mode, GateMode and Uni buttons are read inverted in the code, so the behaviour described here is the one each button gives in the state named. The IN jack takes whatever voltage you want read as bits, so it has no family.
